items.title: Percy Gabriel Interview, 1987-07-10
items.q: He had a brother playing bass... He was playing bass before me, and they'd come along and I was trying to help him out there.

ctx.x: Could, I want to ask you about a saxophone player that you're on me. Could John Handy read?

Most of the time John Handy always had his own band, so I don't know if he read or not. Yeah. He had a brother playing bass, a left-handed fella. He was playing bass before me, and they'd come along and I was trying to help him out there. Yeah. A cap in hand, we called him.
